datasets.name: fin_top_revenue_dates
queryLines:
SELECT
  full_date,
  completed_purchase_count,
  renewal_purchase_count,
  new_subscription_purchase_count,
  gross_collected_amount,
  refund_amount,
  net_revenue
FROM
  gold_finance_metrics_daily
ORDER BY
  gross_collected_amount DESC
LIMIT 10
